verdict.rationale: Lindy is an AI-teammate automation platform with routines and skills, so versioning and dev-to-prod promotion is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no source-control versioning of workflows, no separate environments, and no promotion process. The GitHub mention describes Lindy using GitHub as a tool to trace changes, not versioning its own workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
